questions.questionHtml: Find the number of rectangles in the given figure.
questions.solution:
Rectangle: A rectangle is a four-sided figure or shape and all angles should be right angle.

Square: A square, there are 4 sides and all the four angles are right angles.

Right Angle: A right angle is an angle of exactly 90°, The angle bounded by two lines perpendicular to each other.

A square is a special type of rectangle because it possesses all the properties of a rectangle. Similar to a rectangle, a square has:

  • Opposite sides that are parallel and equal.
  • Two diagonals that bisect each other and are equal.

Thus, a square is a rectangle.

The given figure:

The rectangles in the figure: 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, (1, 2)

Hence, there are 6 rectangles in the figure.

Additional Information

Squares are a subset of rectangles, hence, all squares are also rectangles.

n2 + (n - 1)2 + (n - 2)2 + - - - - - - - - - - + (n - n)2

Now substitute n = 3 in the above formula,

32 + (3 - 1)2 + (3 - 2)2 + (3 - 3)2

9 + 22 + 12 + 0 = 9 + 4 + 1 = 14

If are 2 rows and 2 columns in the above figure. So let n = 2.
